stage_definition: Entry through the instruction preceding the first Butterfly call.
First Butterfly call through the instruction preceding the second Butterfly call, including the second set of input differences.
Second Butterfly call through the entire aligned function end, including dewindow loops and tail alignment.
findings: Narrow local declarations recover the target extension counts for wrapped sums but do not explain its additional zeroing before differences. DWORD spills alone do not establish that the original locals were int.

Retaining a negated v0 in the second fixed-point stage and later evaluating -(v0 + v8) reproduces the target negation count. This alone does not produce an exact stage or complete function and was not promoted.

Hoisted difference assignments, ordinary narrow input temporaries, Split helper argument types, helper return-width combinations, register declarations, and local arrays/structs did not produce a complete match. The array/struct controls change stack allocation and are not supported as the recovered layout.
A narrow MultiplyFraction return adds thirty-two caller extensions in the dewindow stage. The canonical int return remains better supported by the target caller.
All controls are genuine C alternatives in scratch and none supplies instruction bytes, padding, patches or linked application data. No compiler-flag search was performed in this pass.

Canonical Mp3DCT remains 5040 bytes versus the original aligned extent of 5104, with 3986 non-relocation differing positions and the previously recorded 48/48 finite behavioral cases. No source change was made, so those behavioral checks were not repeated.
